description: Watch a job that runs on a schedule and alert the user when it stops running. Returns a URL. Add `&& curl -fsS <pingUrl>` to the END of the user's command, joined with `&&` so it only runs when the job succeeded. Never use `;` — that reports success even when the job failed. After you have wired it up, run the job once and call get_check_in to confirm the first check-in arrived. Do not tell the user it is set up until you have confirmed it.

every.description: How often this job should finish successfully

name.description: Display name for the scheduled job

name: add_check_in

pingUrl.description: Bearer write URL; omitted for read-only connections
